Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You find the question that makes a stranger set aside what they were doing and listen.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One nonhostile creature you share a language with; one minute
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Expert social practice, not compulsory speech or a replacement for roleplay. No card is required to talk, persuade or ask questions.

Weak
1 progress toward a plausible conversation objective; learn one topic the listener openly welcomes.
Standard
2 progress; learn that topic and one concern the listener expresses about your request.
Strong
3 progress, both details above, and a subject it openly shows reluctance to discuss.
